From Mr. President · Price: you need a small object to hold the room, and it can be stolen; binding a room takes 10 minutes, so in combat you can only use a room bound beforehand.

Theme Space

  • 1: 10 minutes: bind an extradimensional room (10 ft cube) to a small object. Creatures and items can enter by touching it. Surge, 1 action: your stand presses the object to a Medium or smaller creature and shoves it into the room (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates). It's shut inside until the start of your next turn, or for 1 minute on a critical failure, and can't affect anything outside; on a success it stays outside, but part of its body is pulled toward the object: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn. Once per turn, when your stand hits a creature with a Strike, it can press the object to it and pull part of its body toward the room: the creature stays outside but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn.
  • 5: The room is 20 ft and has light and air. Your stand can shove up to two creatures within its reach into the room with one use.
  • 9: Resting in it counts as safe, and it holds up to eight creatures.
  • 13: You can bind it to a second object and travel between the two.
  • 17: Creatures inside are hidden from all divinations.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
